title: English in a Minute: A Clean Slate

transcript.text: Welcome to English in a Minute. In a classroom, the chalkboard is also called a slate. It's
important to clean it before starting a new lesson. So does clean slate relate to teaching?
I love the start of the new year. It's a great time to start fresh, make a new start.
Me too. This year, I'm going to start with a clean slate and give up bad habits.
Like eating donuts and drinking too much coffee? No, no other bad habits.
A clean slate means a new start or beginning. This phrase comes from the use of chalk and
slate in classrooms. A teacher could start a new lesson with a clean slate. And that's English in a minute.
